label: If y can be without x and x cannot be without y, then y is PRIOR_4 to x
paraphrase: The being-without criterion of priority in being, In V Metaph. lect. 13 n. 15 (claim ab5ec574), read for PRIOR_4: for all y and x, if y can be without x and x cannot be without y (CanBeWithout, DEF-CAN-BE-WITHOUT), then y is prior to x in being. PRIOR_4 sibling of 97fa3a0b, which concludes PRIOR_1 and whose transport to PRIOR_1 is open. Since PRIOR_4 is defined by this criterion (definition f4365b55), the statement is true by definition and carries no transport.
